title: Northgate Optical Warranty Periods and Remake Limits
content:
**Warranty periods and remake limits of Northgate Optical eyewear, by lens design.** The frame warranty, coating warranty and lab defect guarantee are counted in months after dispensing.

| Lens design | Frame warranty (months) | Coating warranty (months) | Lab defect remade free | Lab defect window (months) | Outside-coverage remake percentage (of the design's base lens price) | Remakes of any kind per job |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Northgate Single Vision Lenses | 12 | 24 | yes | 12 | 50 percent | 2 |
| Northgate Lined Bifocal Lenses | 12 | 24 | yes | 12 | 50 percent | 2 |
| Northgate Lined Trifocal Lenses | 12 | 24 | yes | 12 | 50 percent | 2 |
| Northgate Standard Progressive Lenses | 12 | 24 | yes | 12 | 50 percent | 3 |
| Northgate Premium Progressive Lenses | 12 | 24 | yes | 12 | 40 percent | 3 |
| Northgate Digital Freeform Progressive Lenses | 12 | 24 | yes | 12 | 40 percent | 3 |

### Column notes

- **Frame warranty**: the months after dispensing within which a frame defect is replaced free.
- **Coating warranty**: the months after dispensing within which a coating defect, such as peeling or crazing, is remade free.
- **Lab defect**: whether a lab defect is remade free, and the months after dispensing within which it is.
- **Outside-coverage remake percentage**: a percentage of the job's base lens price — 50 percent on the single vision, lined and standard progressive designs, 40 percent on the premium and digital freeform designs.
- **Remakes of any kind per job**: the most remakes, whatever their reason, one job may have — 2 on the single vision, bifocal and trifocal designs, 3 on the three progressive designs.

### Reading across the table

Every design carries the same 12-month frame warranty, 24-month coating warranty and 12-month lab defect guarantee. The designs differ in two columns only: the outside-coverage remake percentage and the total number of remakes a job may have.
